# Toptal

> Toptal is an exclusive marketplace connecting businesses with top 3% freelance talent including developers, designers, and management consultants.

Toptal operates a verified expert network that matches vetted professionals with companies seeking specialized skills. The platform focuses on quality over quantity, maintaining rigorous screening standards to ensure access to elite talent across software development, product design, and strategic consulting.
